cs.t: Maybe you should invest in a Vectrex, the only vector console. I can remember it also came with a version of Asteroids. This had the CRT magic you describe but despite the charm it looked a bit like an oscilloscope to me. I played this in Woolworths circa 1982 when the thing to buy was a 'proper computer' even if that meant a ZX81 that you soldered yourself. If I can remember correctly the Vectrex was price competitive with the humble ZX81 when new, now they are bound to be worth a relative fortune compared to those allegedly more useful computers that are worth little. Size was also good, you could have a Vectrex on your desk, an Asteroids cabinet would be a bit too bulky for that.
